remarks: This sleek and roomy studio apartment puts you at the heart of Strawberry Hill, one of Stamford's most idyllic and beautiful neighborhoods. Perfect for anybody who wants to be close to the best the city has to offer, the prime location is set back along a quiet street less than two miles from the serene running paths of Scalzi Park. The generous and flowing floor plan takes in a spacious office area just off the entryway, perfect for a young professional still working from home.   On the other side of a half-wall separating the work space, you'll find a wide, open living area with plenty of room for entertaining guests. A big dining area that can comfortably seat four people balances the opposite side of the room. On the far side, meanwhile, you can comfortably fit a queen-size bed and a full dresser under a trio of windows that fill the room with natural light. Just around the corner, finally, sits a fully-equipped kitchen with a stainless steel fridge, dishwasher, and ample cabinet and countertop storage space. When you're looking to get out, the location couldn't be more convenient, putting you five minutes from downtown and close to Chelsea Piers as well as several golf courses, country clubs, and other top attractions. Commuters will also appreciate the close proximity to the train station and I-95.
